translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year the Ningxia garrison in Shaanxi was established with Manchu and Mongol squad leaders, armored cavalry, foot soldiers, and bowyers and smiths across all eight banners.

sentences.zh: 十九年，設福建福州左翼四旗漢軍領催、馬甲、步甲、鐵匠，及滿、蒙步甲。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, at Fuzhou in Fujian, the Left Wing Four Banners' Han Banner squad leaders, armored soldiers, foot soldiers, and iron artisans, and Manchu and Mongol foot soldiers were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year Fuzhou in Fujian received the Left Wing Four Han banner squad leaders, armored and foot soldiers, smiths, and Manchu and Mongol foot soldiers.

sentences.zh: 二十年，設廣東廣州鑲黃、正黃、正白上三旗漢軍領催、馬甲、砲甲、弓匠。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, at Guangzhou in Guangdong, squad leaders, armored soldiers, artillery soldiers, and bow artisans of the upper three Han Banner flags—the Bordered Yellow, Plain Yellow, and Plain White—were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Guangzhou received squad leaders, armored cavalry, artillery troops, and bowyers from the upper three Han banners: Bordered Yellow, Plain Yellow, and Plain White.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，設湖廣荊州八旗滿、蒙領催，馬甲，步甲，弓、鐵匠，共二千八百有奇，尋增至四千人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, at Jingzhou in Huguang, Eight Banner Manchu and Mongol squad leaders, armored soldiers, foot soldiers, and bow and iron artisans were established, more than 2,800 in all; shortly afterward they were increased to 4,000.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the Jingzhou garrison in Huguang was established with Manchu and Mongol squad leaders, armored cavalry, foot soldiers, and bowyers and smiths—more than 2,800 in all, soon raised to 4,000.

sentences.zh: 是年又增西安將軍，增滿洲左右翼副都統各一，漢軍左右翼亦如之，八旗滿、蒙協領各八，漢協領、佐領、防禦、驍騎校不等，滿、蒙、漢兵共七千，滿、蒙步軍七百，暨弓、鐵匠等。

translations.literal: That same year a Xi'an general was also added, one Left Wing and one Right Wing Manchu deputy commander-in-chief each, Han Banner Left and Right Wing deputy commanders likewise, eight Manchu and Mongol assistant commanders per banner, Han assistant commanders, company commanders, defensive officers, and cavalry captains in varying numbers, 7,000 Manchu, Mongol, and Han troops in all, 700 Manchu and Mongol foot soldiers, and bow and iron artisans and the like.
translations.idiomatic: That same year a general was added at Xi'an, with one deputy commander for each Manchu wing and matching Han banner deputies; eight Manchu and Mongol assistant commanders per banner; assorted Han assistant commanders, company commanders, defensive officers, and cavalry captains; 7,000 Manchu, Mongol, and Han troops; 700 Manchu and Mongol foot soldiers; and bowyers, smiths, and the like.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，續設廣州鑲白、正紅、鑲紅、正藍、鑲藍五旗漢軍兵，設將軍一人，副都統二，協領、參領各八，防禦、驍騎校各四十，八旗鳥槍領催、鳥槍驍騎、領催、驍騎、砲驍騎、弓、鐵匠共三千有奇，兼置綠旗左右前後四營，將領八，兵三千四百有奇。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, the five remaining Han Banner flags at Guangzhou—the Plain White, Plain Red, Bordered Red, Plain Blue, and Bordered Blue—were continued; one general, two deputy commanders-in-chief, eight assistant commanders and regimental commanders each, forty defensive officers and cavalry captains each, and more than 3,000 musket squad leaders, musket elite cavalry, squad leaders, elite cavalry, artillery elite cavalry, bow and iron artisans across the Eight Banners were established; concurrently the four Green Standard camps—Left, Right, Front, and Rear—were set up with eight officers and more than 3,400 troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the five remaining Han banners were added at Guangzhou—Plain White, Plain Red, Bordered Red, Plain Blue, and Bordered Blue—with one general, two deputy commanders, eight assistant and regimental commanders each, forty defensive officers and cavalry captains each, and more than 3,000 musket squad leaders, musket cavalry, squad leaders, elite cavalry, artillery cavalry, bowyers, and smiths across all eight banners; four Green Standard camps—Left, Right, Front, and Rear—were also established with eight officers and more than 3,400 troops.

sentences.zh: 尋於福州、荊州、寧夏、江寧、京口、杭州並分設鳥槍領催、鳥槍驍騎、領催、驍騎各有差。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward musket squad leaders, musket elite cavalry, squad leaders, and elite cavalry were separately established at Fuzhou, Jingzhou, Ningxia, Jiangning, Jingkou, and Hangzhou, each in fixed numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Musket squad leaders, musket cavalry, squad leaders, and elite cavalry were soon established separately at Fuzhou, Jingzhou, Ningxia, Jiangning, Jingkou, and Hangzhou in allotted numbers.

sentences.zh: 京口步軍內兼設鳥槍、弓、箭、長槍、藤牌等兵額。

translations.literal: Within the Jingkou foot troops, quotas were also established for musket troops, archers, arrow troops, long-spear troops, rattan-shield troops, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingkou foot contingent also included allotted posts for musketmen, archers, arrow troops, long-spearmen, and rattan-shield troops.

sentences.zh: 是年增設杭州駐防八旗滿、蒙、漢兵共三千二百人。

translations.literal: That year the Hangzhou garrison Eight Banner Manchu, Mongol, and Han troops were additionally established, 3,200 in all.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the Hangzhou garrison was expanded by 3,200 Manchu, Mongol, and Han banner troops.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，設山西右衛八旗滿、蒙、漢護軍、領催、馬甲、鐵匠共五千六百有奇，以將軍統之，設隨甲四十八，筆帖式六。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, at Youwei in Shanxi, Eight Banner Manchu, Mongol, and Han guards, squad leaders, armored soldiers, and iron artisans were established, more than 5,600 in all, commanded by a general; forty-eight orderlies and six clerks were also appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year the Youwei garrison in Shanxi was established with Manchu, Mongol, and Han guards, squad leaders, armored cavalry, and smiths—more than 5,600 in all under one general—with forty-eight orderlies and six clerks.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，裁京口綠旗水師總兵，改設京口副將，分左右二營，設游擊以下將領八人，兵一千九百人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, the Jingkou Green Standard naval brigade commander was abolished; a Jingkou vice commander was established instead, with Left and Right camps, eight officers from brigade commander downward, and 1,900 troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year the Jingkou Green Standard naval commander was abolished and replaced by a vice commander overseeing Left and Right camps with eight subordinate officers and 1,900 troops.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，設河南開封滿、蒙領催，鳥槍領催，馬甲，鳥槍馬甲，弓、鐵匠。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year, at Kaifeng in Henan, Manchu and Mongol squad leaders, musket squad leaders, armored soldiers, musket armored soldiers, and bow and iron artisans were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year the Kaifeng garrison in Henan was established with Manchu and Mongol squad leaders, musket squad leaders, armored cavalry, musket-armed cavalry, and bowyers and smiths.

sentences.zh: 六十年，設四川成都副都統一，協領四，佐領、防禦、驍騎校、鳥槍領催、鳥槍驍騎、驍騎暨步軍，弓、箭、鐵匠。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year, at Chengdu in Sichuan one deputy commander-in-chief, four assistant commanders, company commanders, defensive officers, cavalry captains, musket squad leaders, musket elite cavalry, elite cavalry, foot soldiers, and bow, arrow, and iron artisans were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year the Chengdu garrison in Sichuan received one deputy commander, four assistant commanders, and company commanders, defensive officers, cavalry captains, musket squad leaders, musket cavalry, elite cavalry, foot soldiers, and bowyers, fletchers, and smiths.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，福州駐防漢軍步兵悉改馬兵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, all Han Banner foot soldiers in the Fuzhou garrison were changed to cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng all Han banner foot soldiers at the Fuzhou garrison were reclassified as cavalry.

sentences.zh: 二年，增太原、德州駐防兵各五百人。

translations.literal: In the second year, 500 garrison troops each were added at Taiyuan and Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Taiyuan and Dezhou each received 500 additional garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 六年，設福州駐防水師營協領一人，佐領、防禦各二，驍騎校六，水師五百。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, one naval brigade assistant commander, two company commanders and defensive officers each, six cavalry captains, and 500 naval troops were established for the Fuzhou garrison naval camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Fuzhou garrison naval camp received one assistant commander, two company commanders and defensive officers each, six cavalry captains, and 500 naval troops.

sentences.zh: 七年，設駐防浙江乍浦水師營。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the naval brigade garrison camp at Zhapu in Zhejiang was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year a naval garrison camp was established at Zhapu in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 設青州駐防將軍、副都統各一人，協領四，佐領、防禦、驍騎校十六，暨八旗滿、蒙兵弓、鐵匠。

translations.literal: At Qingzhou one garrison general and one deputy commander-in-chief, four assistant commanders, sixteen company commanders, defensive officers, and cavalry captains, and Eight Banner Manchu and Mongol troops plus bow and iron artisans were established.
translations.idiomatic: The Qingzhou garrison was established with one general and one deputy commander, four assistant commanders, sixteen company commanders, defensive officers, and cavalry captains, and Manchu and Mongol banner troops plus bowyers and smiths.

sentences.zh: 設廣州駐防水師營協領一人，佐領、防禦各二，驍騎校、八旗漢軍水師領催有差。

translations.literal: For the Guangzhou garrison naval camp one assistant commander, two company commanders and defensive officers each, cavalry captains, and Han Banner naval squad leaders in fixed numbers were established.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangzhou garrison naval camp received one assistant commander, two company commanders and defensive officers each, cavalry captains, and Han banner naval squad leaders in allotted numbers.

sentences.zh: 八年，以各省駐防漢軍營伍廢弛，令所在將軍訓練之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because Han Banner units in provincial garrisons had grown lax, the local generals were ordered to drill them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, finding Han banner units in provincial garrisons had fallen into neglect, the throne ordered local generals to drill them.

sentences.zh: 設駐防青州八旗滿洲兵二千人。

translations.literal: Two thousand Manchu troops of the Eight Banners garrison at Qingzhou were established.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand Manchu banner troops were assigned to the Qingzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 增右衛駐防兵五百人，自將軍及兩翼副都統以下，設協領，佐領，防禦，驍騎校，滿、蒙前鋒，滿、蒙、漢領催等，及驍騎三千有奇。

translations.literal: Five hundred Youwei garrison troops were added; from the general and the Left and Right Wing deputy commanders downward, assistant commanders, company commanders, defensive officers, cavalry captains, Manchu and Mongol vanguard troops, Manchu, Mongol, and Han squad leaders, and the like were established, with more than 3,000 elite cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: The Youwei garrison gained 500 troops and, from the general and wing deputies downward, assistant commanders, company commanders, defensive officers, cavalry captains, Manchu and Mongol vanguard, and Manchu, Mongol, and Han squad leaders, with more than 3,000 elite cavalry.

sentences.zh: 十三年，設甘肅涼州八旗滿、蒙、漢兵凡二千人。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Manchu, Mongol, and Han troops of the Eight Banners at Liangzhou in Gansu were established, 2,000 in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year 2,000 Manchu, Mongol, and Han banner troops were assigned to the Liangzhou garrison in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 設駐防庄浪八旗滿、蒙、漢兵凡千人。

translations.literal: One thousand Manchu, Mongol, and Han troops of the Eight Banners garrison at Zhuanglang were established.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand Manchu, Mongol, and Han banner troops were assigned to the Zhuanglang garrison.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，設駐防綏遠城，以征準噶爾之滿、蒙、漢開戶家丁二千四百，熱河駐防兵千，及右衛蒙古兵五百，凡三千九百人。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong, a garrison at Suiyuan City was established with 2,400 registered Manchu, Mongol, and Han household retainers drawn from the campaign against the Dzungars, 1,000 Rehe garrison troops, and 500 Youwei Mongol troops—3,900 in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianlong a garrison was established at Suiyuan City with 2,400 registered Manchu, Mongol, and Han household retainers from the Dzungar campaign, 1,000 troops from the Rehe garrison, and 500 Mongol troops from Youwei—3,900 in all.

sentences.zh: 設涼州將軍、副都統各一人，滿、蒙、漢佐領、防禦、驍騎校、步軍尉及八旗驍騎二千人，步軍六百人。

translations.literal: One Liangzhou general and one deputy commander-in-chief, Manchu, Mongol, and Han company commanders, defensive officers, cavalry captains, foot soldier officers, and 2,000 elite cavalry of the Eight Banners and 600 foot soldiers were established.
translations.idiomatic: The Liangzhou garrison received one general and one deputy commander, Manchu, Mongol, and Han company commanders, defensive officers, cavalry captains, and foot soldier officers, with 2,000 banner elite cavalry and 600 foot soldiers.

sentences.zh: 又設庄浪駐防副都統一人，滿、蒙、漢協領、佐領、防禦、步軍尉及八旗驍騎一千人，步軍四百人。

translations.literal: One Zhuanglang garrison deputy commander-in-chief, Manchu, Mongol, and Han assistant commanders, company commanders, defensive officers, foot soldier officers, and 1,000 elite cavalry of the Eight Banners and 400 foot soldiers were also established.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhuanglang garrison likewise received one deputy commander, Manchu, Mongol, and Han assistant commanders, company commanders, defensive officers, and foot soldier officers, with 1,000 banner elite cavalry and 400 foot soldiers.

sentences.zh: 四年，改寧夏駐防步甲六百為養育兵。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, 600 Ningxia garrison foot soldiers were changed to training soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year 600 foot soldiers at the Ningxia garrison were reclassified as training soldiers.

sentences.zh: 增荊州養育兵四百人。

translations.literal: Four hundred Jingzhou training soldiers were added.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou received 400 additional training soldiers.

sentences.zh: 十年，設江寧駐防養育兵。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Jiangning garrison training soldiers were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year training soldiers were established at the Jiangning garrison.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，定開封城守尉歸巡撫統轄。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, it was fixed that the Kaifeng city garrison captain would come under the provincial governor's command.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the Kaifeng city garrison captain was placed under the provincial governor's command.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，裁京口將軍，以綠旗左右營改隸江寧將軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, the Jingkou general was abolished, and the Green Standard Left and Right camps were transferred to the Jiangning general's command.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the Jingkou general was abolished and the Green Standard Left and Right camps were reassigned to the Jiangning general.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，改綏遠城將軍駐防兵額，步軍、養育兵各四百，共領催、前鋒、驍騎實二千四百人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, the Suiyuan City garrison troop quotas were revised: 400 foot soldiers and 400 training soldiers each, with squad leaders, vanguard, and elite cavalry totaling 2,400 actual effectives.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Suiyuan City's garrison quotas were revised to 400 foot soldiers and 400 training soldiers, with squad leaders, vanguard, and elite cavalry bringing actual strength to 2,400.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，以土默特二旗歸綏遠城將軍統轄。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, the two Tumed banners were placed under the Suiyuan City general's command.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year the two Tumed banners were placed under the Suiyuan City general.

sentences.zh: 設歸化城副都統一人。

translations.literal: One Guihuacheng deputy commander-in-chief was established.
translations.idiomatic: One deputy commander was established at Guihuacheng.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，改杭州駐防步軍一百二十八人為養育兵。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, 128 Hangzhou garrison foot soldiers were changed to training soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year 128 foot soldiers at the Hangzhou garrison were reclassified as training soldiers.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，設成都駐防將軍一人。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, one Chengdu garrison general was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year a general was established at the Chengdu garrison.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，增西安副都統一人。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year, one Xi'an deputy commander-in-chief was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year one deputy commander was added at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十二年，飭各將軍不得以老弱充兵額。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Jiaqing, all generals were ordered not to fill troop quotas with the aged and weak.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Jiaqing generals were forbidden to fill troop quotas with the aged and infirm.

sentences.zh: 此各直省駐防制也。

translations.literal: This was the garrison system of the various provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the garrison system of the provinces.

sentences.zh: 新疆駐防兵制，乾隆二十五年，始議於新疆設兵駐守。

translations.literal: As for the Xinjiang garrison troop system, in the twenty-fifth year of Qianlong planning first began to station troops in Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The Xinjiang garrison system began in the twenty-fifth year of Qianlong, when the court first resolved to post troops there.

sentences.zh: 命阿桂率滿洲、索倫驍騎五百，綠營兵百，回人二百，至伊犁搜捕馬哈沁，招撫厄魯特，並築城屯墾。

translations.literal: Agui was ordered to lead 500 Manchu and Solon elite cavalry, 100 Green Standard troops, and 200 Muslims to Yili to hunt down the Khoshut, win over the Oirat, and build fortified settlements and open fields.
translations.idiomatic: Agui was dispatched with 500 Manchu and Solon cavalry, 100 Green Standard troops, and 200 Muslim auxiliaries to Yili to hunt down Khoshut bands, win over the Oirat, and build fortified settlements for colonization.

sentences.zh: 其後陸續由內地增調屯田兵至二千五百人，五年更替，以五百人差操，二千人屯種，分二十五屯，設屯鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Thereafter colonization troops were continually added from the interior to 2,500; they rotated every five years, 500 on duty and 2,000 farming, divided into twenty-five colonies, with a colonization garrison brigade commander established.
translations.idiomatic: Colony troops were steadily reinforced from the interior until they reached 2,500, rotating every five years: 500 on active duty and 2,000 farming, organized in twenty-five colonies under a colonization brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 其明年，阿桂奏定卡倫侍衛十五人，增伊犁駐防馬兵千五百，合原額兵凡二千五百人。

translations.literal: The following year Agui memorialized to fix fifteen karun guards; 1,500 cavalry were added to the Yili garrison, making 2,500 troops in all with the original quota.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Agui proposed fixing fifteen karun guards and adding 1,500 cavalry to the Yili garrison, bringing total strength to 2,500 with the existing quota.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，以涼州、庄浪駐防兵五千，並戶口移駐伊犁。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, 5,000 Liangzhou and Zhuanglang garrison troops and their households were moved to garrison Yili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year 5,000 garrison troops and their families from Liangzhou and Zhuanglang were relocated to Yili.

sentences.zh: 旋以新疆底定，設駐防兵制。

translations.literal: Soon, once Xinjiang was pacified, the garrison troop system was established.
translations.idiomatic: Once Xinjiang was pacified, a formal garrison system was instituted.

sentences.zh: 凡卡倫兵以侍衛領之，屯田兵以督屯武職領之，駐防馬兵以佐領領之，綠旗兵以營員領之，而特設將軍為之總轄。

translations.literal: Karun troops were commanded by guards; colonization troops by military colonization officers; garrison cavalry by company commanders; Green Standard troops by camp officers—and a general was specially established as overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: Karun troops answered to guards, colonization troops to military colonization officers, garrison cavalry to company commanders, and Green Standard troops to camp officers, all under a specially appointed general.

sentences.zh: 侍衛、章京等皆按年番替。

translations.literal: Guards, clerks, and the like all rotated by the year.
translations.idiomatic: Guards, clerks, and similar officials rotated annually.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，調綠營兵千，在伊犁河岸築惠遠城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, 1,000 Green Standard troops were transferred to build Huining City on the Ili River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year 1,000 Green Standard troops built Huining City on the Ili River.

sentences.zh: 其管理築城兵，設副將一，守備二，千總二，把總八。

translations.literal: To manage the city-building troops, one vice commander, two garrison commanders, two battalion commanders, and eight platoon commanders were established.
translations.idiomatic: Overseeing the construction force were one vice commander, two garrison commanders, two battalion commanders, and eight platoon commanders.

sentences.zh: 以察哈爾移駐兵一千八百戶編兩昂吉，領隊大臣統之，設十二佐領，分左右二翼，每佐領設兵二百。

translations.literal: 1,800 Chahar households relocated for garrison duty were organized into two angji, commanded by a brigade minister, with twelve company commanders established in Left and Right wings, two hundred troops per company commander.
translations.idiomatic: 1,800 relocated Chahar households were organized into two angji under a brigade minister, with twelve company commanders in left and right wings, each commanding 200 troops.

sentences.zh: 以黑龍江移駐戶千編一昂吉，設六佐領，領隊大臣統之。

translations.literal: One thousand Heilongjiang relocated households were organized into one angji, with six company commanders, commanded by a brigade minister.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand relocated Heilongjiang households formed one angji under a brigade minister with six company commanders.

sentences.zh: 又撥錫伯兵、熱河滿、蒙兵各一千，及達什達瓦厄魯特兵五百，俱攜眷駐伊犁。

translations.literal: 1,000 Xibe troops, 1,000 Rehe Manchu and Mongol troops, and 500 Dashdawa Oirat troops were also allocated, all bringing families to garrison Yili.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand Xibe troops, 1,000 Rehe Manchu and Mongol troops, and 500 Dashdawa Oirat troops were also assigned, all relocating with their families to Yili.

sentences.zh: 定馬兵永遠駐守，綠旗兵五年番換。

translations.literal: It was fixed that cavalry would garrison permanently, while Green Standard troops would rotate every five years.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry were permanently posted; Green Standard troops rotated every five years.

sentences.zh: 三十年，以投出之厄魯特人編一昂吉，與達什達瓦部眾俱為厄魯特昂吉，以領隊大臣統之。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, surrendered Oirat people were organized into one angji; together with the Dashdawa tribesmen they formed the Oirat angji, commanded by a brigade minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year surrendered Oirat were organized into one angji; together with the Dashdawa tribesmen they formed the Oirat angji under a brigade minister.

sentences.zh: 原厄魯特兵作厄魯特右翼。

translations.literal: The original Oirat troops became the Oirat Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: The original Oirat force became the Oirat Right Wing.

sentences.zh: 自領隊大臣以下，二三等侍衛、藍翎侍衛無定員。

translations.literal: From the brigade minister downward, second- and third-rank guards and blue-plume guards had no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Below the brigade minister, second- and third-rank guards and blue-plume guards had no fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，定烏魯木齊駐辦事大臣及協辦大臣，統駐防兵及工作官兵，置經理新疆貿易、稽察卡倫台站各官。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, the Urumqi resident minister and assistant resident minister were fixed; they commanded garrison troops and construction troops and craftsmen, and officials managing Xinjiang trade and inspecting karun and relay stations were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year Urumqi received a resident minister and assistant minister commanding garrison and construction forces and overseeing trade, karun inspection, and relay stations.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，定左翼厄魯特六佐領為上三旗，右翼厄魯特共十佐領編為下五旗。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, the six company commanders of the Left Wing Oirat were fixed as the upper three banners, and the ten company commanders of the Right Wing Oirat were organized as the lower five banners.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year the Oirat Left Wing's six company commanders were designated the upper three banners and the Right Wing's ten company commanders the lower five banners.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，增惠寧城滿兵領隊大臣一人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, one Manchu troop brigade minister was added at Huining City.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year Huining City gained one Manchu brigade minister.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，以投誠之沙畢納爾人等歸入下五旗厄魯特，增設四佐領統之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year, surrendered Shabinar and others were incorporated into the lower five Oirat banners, with four additional company commanders established to command them.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year surrendered Shabinar and others joined the lower five Oirat banners under four new company commanders.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二十年，於沙畢納爾四佐領內增副總管一人。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Jiaqing, one deputy superintendent was added within the four Shabinar company commands.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Jiaqing one deputy superintendent was added among the four Shabinar company commands.

sentences.zh: 道光十年，以惠遠城滿兵四千六百有奇，巴燕岱滿兵二千一百有奇，諭將軍等不得議增兵額。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Daoguang, with more than 4,600 Manchu troops at Huining City and more than 2,100 at Bayandai, the general and others were instructed not to propose increasing troop quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Daoguang, with more than 4,600 Manchu troops at Huining City and more than 2,100 at Bayandai, generals were forbidden to propose further increases to troop quotas.

sentences.zh: 同治六年，以哈薩克人東犯，飭李雲麟訓練厄魯特、蒙古兵以防之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tongzhi, because Kazakhs raided from the east, Li Yunlin was ordered to drill Oirat and Mongol troops to guard against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tongzhi, after Kazakh raids from the east, Li Yunlin was ordered to drill Oirat and Mongol troops for defense.

sentences.zh: 增布倫托海辦事大臣，督率喇嘛，建署治事，並設幫辦一人。

translations.literal: The Buruntokhai resident minister was added to supervise lamas, build an office to conduct affairs, and one assistant was also established.
translations.idiomatic: A resident minister was added at Buruntokhai to supervise lamas and administer affairs from a new office, with one assistant.

sentences.zh: 此屬新疆北路者也。

translations.literal: This pertained to the Northern Route of Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: This covered the Northern Route of Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 其在南路防兵，烏什駐總理回務參贊大臣、協辦大臣各一人，統轄滿洲、綠旗及屯田各官兵，兼轄阿克蘇、賽里木、拜城各駐防兵。

translations.literal: As for the southern-route defense troops, at Ush one superintendent of Muslim affairs and one assistant resident minister each were garrisoned, commanding Manchu, Green Standard, and colonization troops and officials, and also commanding garrison troops at Aksu, Sayram, and Baicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the southern route Ush was garrisoned by a superintendent of Muslim affairs and an assistant minister commanding Manchu, Green Standard, and colonization forces and overseeing garrisons at Aksu, Sayram, and Baicheng.

sentences.zh: 所屬有侍衛、章京等官。

translations.literal: Subordinate to them were guards, clerks, and other officials.
translations.idiomatic: They were assisted by guards, clerks, and other officials.

sentences.zh: 滿洲營領隊侍衛二，駐轄翼長、參領各一，副參領、委署參領各二，前鋒校六，綠旗營游擊以下、屯田副將以下各十八人。

translations.literal: The Manchu camp had two brigade guards, one garrison wing commander and one regimental commander each, two deputy regimental commanders and acting regimental commanders each, six vanguard officers, eighteen Green Standard officers from brigade commander downward, and eighteen colonization officers from vice commander downward.
translations.idiomatic: The Manchu camp fielded two brigade guards, one wing commander and one regimental commander, two deputy and acting regimental commanders each, six vanguard officers, eighteen Green Standard officers down to brigade commander, and eighteen colonization officers down to vice commander.

sentences.zh: 阿克蘇駐章京一，綠旗營游擊一。

translations.literal: At Aksu one clerk and one Green Standard brigade commander were garrisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Aksu was garrisoned by one clerk and one Green Standard brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 賽里木駐翼長一，兼統拜城駐防。

translations.literal: At Sayram one wing commander was garrisoned, also commanding the Baicheng garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Sayram held one wing commander who also commanded the Baicheng garrison.

sentences.zh: 葉爾羌駐辦事參贊大臣及領隊大臣，統轄滿洲營領隊副都統、侍衛、參領、副參領等，如烏什例。

translations.literal: At Yarkand a resident minister and brigade minister were garrisoned, commanding the Manchu camp deputy commander-in-chief, guards, regimental commanders, deputy regimental commanders, and the like, following the Ush precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Yarkand was garrisoned by a resident minister and brigade minister commanding a Manchu camp deputy commander, guards, regimental and deputy regimental commanders, and the like on the Ush model.

sentences.zh: 和闐、喀什噶爾並駐辦事大臣及領隊大臣，統轄滿洲營侍衛、章京、領隊侍衛、參領、副參領等，暨綠營總兵、參將等官。

translations.literal: At Khotan and Kashgar resident ministers and brigade ministers were also garrisoned, commanding Manchu camp guards, clerks, brigade guards, regimental commanders, deputy regimental commanders, and the like, and Green Standard brigade commanders and regimental commanders and other officials.
translations.idiomatic: Khotan and Kashgar likewise received resident and brigade ministers commanding Manchu camp guards, clerks, brigade guards, regimental and deputy regimental commanders, and Green Standard brigade and regimental commanders.

sentences.zh: 庫車駐辦事官，統轄綠營都司以下官，兼轄沙雅爾事。

translations.literal: At Kucha a resident official was garrisoned, commanding Green Standard officers from battalion commander downward and also overseeing Shayar affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Kucha held a resident official commanding Green Standard officers from battalion commander downward and overseeing Shayar affairs.

sentences.zh: 哈喇沙爾駐辦事官，統轄綠旗營城守，及屯田駐防兵。

translations.literal: At Karashahr a resident official was garrisoned, commanding Green Standard city garrisons and colonization garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Karashahr held a resident official commanding Green Standard city garrisons and colonization troops.

sentences.zh: 辟展駐領隊大臣一，統協領、佐領以下暨步兵、綠旗兵。

translations.literal: At Pizhan one brigade minister was garrisoned, commanding assistant commanders, company commanders, and subordinates together with foot soldiers and Green Standard troops.
translations.idiomatic: Pizhan held one brigade minister commanding assistant and company commanders and their subordinates along with foot soldiers and Green Standard troops.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十四年以後，於烏什駐辦事大臣，阿克蘇駐辦事大臣、協辦大臣各一人，葉爾羌設辦事大臣二人，及章京、卡倫侍衛等。

translations.literal: After the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong, resident ministers were garrisoned at Ush; resident and assistant resident ministers at Aksu; two resident ministers at Yarkand; and guards, karun guards, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: After the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong resident ministers were posted at Ush, a resident and assistant minister at Aksu, two resident ministers at Yarkand, plus guards and karun guards.

sentences.zh: 滿洲營設副都統一人，統健銳營前鋒參領、副參領等，安西滿洲營佐領五品官、索倫五品官、察哈爾佐領等，綠營總兵、游擊以下各官。

translations.literal: The Manchu camp had one deputy commander-in-chief established, commanding Vanguard Camp vanguard regimental and deputy regimental commanders and the like, Anxi Manchu camp fifth-rank company commanders, Solon fifth-rank officers, Chahar company commanders, and the like, and Green Standard brigade commanders and officers from brigade commander downward.
translations.idiomatic: The Manchu camp received one deputy commander overseeing Vanguard Camp regimental and deputy regimental commanders, Anxi Manchu fifth-rank company commanders, Solon fifth-rank officers, Chahar company commanders, and Green Standard brigade commanders and subordinates.

sentences.zh: 又於和闐駐領隊總兵官及游擊以下。

translations.literal: At Khotan a brigade brigade commander and officers from brigade commander downward were also garrisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Khotan also received a brigade commander and Green Standard officers down to brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 又喀什噶爾駐總兵、理回疆事務大臣、協辦大臣各一。

translations.literal: At Kashgar one brigade commander, one minister for Muslim frontier affairs, and one assistant minister were garrisoned.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar was garrisoned by one brigade commander, one minister for Muslim frontier affairs, and one assistant minister.

sentences.zh: 滿洲營設副都統一，領隊侍衛二。

translations.literal: The Manchu camp had one deputy commander-in-chief and two brigade guards established.
translations.idiomatic: The Manchu camp received one deputy commander and two brigade guards.

sentences.zh: 領隊侍衛兼統索倫兵。

translations.literal: The brigade guard also commanded Solon troops.
translations.idiomatic: The brigade guard also commanded Solon troops.

sentences.zh: 索倫設委署副總管及佐領各二，察哈爾總管一，副總管二，及護軍校以下。

translations.literal: For the Solon there were established two acting assistant commandants and two company commanders each; for the Chahar one commandant, two assistant commandants, and ranks from corporal-of-the-guard downward.
translations.idiomatic: The Solon received two acting assistant commandants and two company commanders; the Chahar received one commandant, two assistant commandants, and officers down to corporal-of-the-guard.

sentences.zh: 綠營設提督及都司以下官。

translations.literal: The Green Standard Army had a regional commander and officers from battalion commander downward established.
translations.idiomatic: The Green Standard Army received a regional commander and officers from battalion commander downward.

sentences.zh: 英阿薩爾駐領隊總兵官一，兼統索倫、察哈爾、綠旗兵。

translations.literal: At Ying'asar one brigade commander was garrisoned, also commanding Solon, Chahar, and Green Standard troops.
translations.idiomatic: Ying'asar held one brigade commander who also commanded Solon, Chahar, and Green Standard troops.

sentences.zh: 又於庫車、哈喇沙爾、辟展並駐辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Resident ministers were also garrisoned at Kucha, Karashahr, and Pizhan.
translations.idiomatic: Resident ministers were also posted at Kucha, Karashahr, and Pizhan.

sentences.zh: 初台站之改，屬辟展者凡六。

translations.literal: At first, of the postal-station reforms, six belonged to Pizhan.
translations.idiomatic: When the postal stations were first reorganized, six fell under Pizhan.

sentences.zh: 每台置外委千、把總一人。

translations.literal: Each station had one acting thousand-man captain or platoon captain appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Each station received one acting thousand-man or platoon captain.

sentences.zh: 葉爾羌西路南北路卡倫六，各置坐卡侍衛一人，東西南三路凡二十一台，各置筆帖式一人。

translations.literal: On Yarkand's western route there were six karun on the northern and southern routes, each with one karun guard; on the eastern, southern, and western routes there were twenty-one stations in all, each with one clerk.
translations.idiomatic: On Yarkand's western route six karun on the north and south routes each had a karun guard; on the east, south, and west routes twenty-one stations each had a clerk.

sentences.zh: 沙雅爾南路卡倫一。

translations.literal: On Shayar's southern route there was one karun.
translations.idiomatic: Shayar's southern route had one karun.

sentences.zh: 庫車東路至哈喇沙爾西凡十台。

translations.literal: From Kucha's eastern route to Karashahr's west there were ten stations in all.
translations.idiomatic: From Kucha's eastern route to Karashahr's west there were ten stations in all.

sentences.zh: 台置筆帖式一人。

translations.literal: Each station had one clerk appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Each station had one clerk.

sentences.zh: 每台、卡俱置防守兵，多至十人，少或一人，俱有供役回人十戶。

translations.literal: Every station and karun had garrison troops posted, at most ten men and at least one; each also had ten Muslim households for supply service.
translations.idiomatic: Every station and karun had garrison troops—up to ten men, as few as one—and ten Muslim households assigned for supply service.

sentences.zh: 尋各官兵歸併烏什、阿克蘇，止駐一章京及游擊以下，旋改駐協辦大臣及領隊侍衛等。

translations.literal: Soon all officers and troops were consolidated into Ush and Aksu; only one clerk and officers from brigade commander downward remained garrisoned; soon this was changed to an assistant resident minister and brigade guards and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the officers and troops were consolidated at Ush and Aksu, leaving only one clerk and officers down to brigade commander; this was soon changed to an assistant resident minister and brigade guards.

sentences.zh: 喀什噶爾之總理大臣移駐烏什之永寧，尋改設辦事大臣二人。

translations.literal: Kashgar's superintendent minister was moved to Yongning in Ush; soon two resident ministers were established instead.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar's superintendent minister was transferred to Yongning in Ush, and two resident ministers were soon appointed in his place.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，撤回索倫兵，改遣健銳營兵九百人換防，並令健銳營翼領一人，正副委署參領十八人，護軍校二十四人，統兵分駐各回城。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Solon troops were withdrawn and nine hundred Vanguard Camp troops were sent on rotation in their place; one wing commander, eighteen acting regimental and deputy regimental commanders, and twenty-four corporals-of-the-guard were ordered to command troops distributed among the Muslim cities.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year the Solon troops were withdrawn and nine hundred Vanguard Camp men sent on rotation; one wing commander, eighteen acting regimental and deputy regimental commanders, and twenty-four corporals-of-the-guard then distributed the garrison among the Muslim cities.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，裁辟展辦事大臣，改設領隊大臣。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, the Pizhan resident minister was abolished and a brigade minister was established in his place.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year the Pizhan resident minister was abolished and replaced by a brigade minister.

sentences.zh: 旋設吐魯番屯田都司以下官。

translations.literal: Soon colonization officials from battalion commander downward were established at Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Turfan received colonization officials from battalion commander downward.

sentences.zh: 道光八年，以阿克蘇為南路適中之地，增兵一千，移柯爾坪防兵五百歸阿克蘇，裁拜城參將以下弁兵，共新舊防兵二千二百人，守卡借差兵外，得練兵一千三百人，控制各路。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Daoguang, because Aksu was the central point of the southern route, one thousand troops were added; five hundred garrison troops from Korpin were moved to Aksu; the Bay regimental commander and subordinate officers and troops were cut; old and new garrison troops totaled two thousand two hundred; apart from karun guards and detail troops, one thousand three hundred drill troops were available to control all routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Daoguang Aksu, as the central point of the southern route, received one thousand additional troops; five hundred Korpin garrison troops were transferred there and Bay's regimental commander and his men were cut. Old and new garrisons totaled 2,200 men; apart from karun guards and detail troops, 1,300 drill troops remained to control all routes.

sentences.zh: 九年，於喀什噶爾邊增八卡倫弁兵。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, eight karun officers and troops were added on the Kashgar frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year eight karun officers and troops were added on the Kashgar frontier.

sentences.zh: 尋以八卡倫內喀浪圭、圖舒克塔、烏拍拉特三處通霍罕要路，於明約洛建堡，設都司一人，綠營兵二百人駐守。

translations.literal: Soon, because among the eight karun Karanggui, Tushukta, and Wopalat were key routes to Kokand, a fort was built at Ming Yaoluo; one battalion commander and two hundred Green Standard troops were garrisoned there.
translations.idiomatic: Soon three of the eight karun—Karanggui, Tushukta, and Wopalat—were recognized as key routes to Kokand; a fort was built at Ming Yaoluo with one battalion commander and two hundred Green Standard troops.

sentences.zh: 阿爾瑚馬廠三處建堡，置兵二百或六十人。

translations.literal: At three places in Arhumachang forts were built, with garrisons of two hundred or sixty men posted.
translations.idiomatic: Forts were built at three places in Arhumachang, garrisoned by two hundred or sixty men.

sentences.zh: 葉爾羌屬卡倫七，以亮葛爾、庫庫雅爾為通夷要隘，英吉沙爾屬卡倫五，惟烏魯克為要路，皆建土堡兵房，設千總官，其次設把總、外委，駐守兵多者六十人，少者十五或十人。

translations.literal: Yarkand had seven subordinate karun; Liangge'er and Kukuyar were key passes to the barbarians. Yengisar had five subordinate karun, of which Wuluk alone was a key route. All had earthen forts and barracks built, thousand-man captains appointed, and below them platoon captains and acting officers; garrisons numbered at most sixty men and at least fifteen or ten.
translations.idiomatic: Yarkand had seven subordinate karun, with Liangge'er and Kukuyar as key passes to the frontier tribes; Yengisar had five, of which only Wuluk was a major route. All were provided with earthen forts and barracks, thousand-man captains, and below them platoon captains and acting officers; garrisons ranged from sixty men down to fifteen or ten.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，以新疆南北兩路駐兵四萬餘人，歲餉一百四十五萬，軍興後饋餫艱難，諭陝、甘赴口外駐防官自是年始，即行停止。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng, because more than forty thousand troops were garrisoned on Xinjiang's northern and southern routes and annual pay amounted to 1.45 million taels, and after the military campaigns supply transport was difficult, an edict ordered that officials from Shaanxi and Gansu sent to garrison beyond the pass cease from that year onward.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng, with more than 40,000 troops garrisoned on Xinjiang's northern and southern routes and annual pay at 1.45 million taels, post-campaign supply had become difficult; an edict halted the dispatch of Shaanxi and Gansu officials to frontier garrisons from that year on.

sentences.zh: 其喀什噶爾、英吉沙爾、葉爾羌、和闐八城防兵，由烏魯木齊駐防滿洲兵、綠旗兵酌撥。

translations.literal: Garrison troops for Kashgar, Yengisar, Yarkand, Khotan, and the other cities of the eight-city circuit were drawn as needed from Manchu and Green Standard troops garrisoned at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: Garrisons for Kashgar, Yengisar, Yarkand, Khotan, and the other cities of the eight-city circuit were supplied from Manchu and Green Standard troops stationed at Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 四年，改定新疆南路換防兵制。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the rotation-garrison system for southern Xinjiang was revised.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the rotation-garrison system for southern Xinjiang was revised.

sentences.zh: 增伊犁滿洲兵二百人，烏魯木齊綠營兵千二百人，滿洲兵三百人。

translations.literal: Two hundred Manchu troops were added at Ili; one thousand two hundred Green Standard troops and three hundred Manchu troops at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: Ili received two hundred additional Manchu troops; Urumqi received 1,200 Green Standard and three hundred Manchu troops.

sentences.zh: 裁葉爾羌、喀什噶爾、烏什、阿克蘇四城防兵一千人。

translations.literal: One thousand garrison troops were cut from the four cities of Yarkand, Kashgar, Ush, and Aksu.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand garrison troops were cut from Yarkand, Kashgar, Ush, and Aksu.

sentences.zh: 七年，以喀城肅清，撤回土爾扈特蒙兵，留伊犁官兵防守。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, because Kashgar had been pacified, Torghut Mongol troops were withdrawn and Ili officers and troops were retained for defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, with Kashgar pacified, Torghut Mongol troops were withdrawn and Ili officers and troops kept on for defense.

sentences.zh: 八年，令南路換防官兵自是年始，分六年抽換，以節繁費。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, southern-route rotation garrisons were ordered to begin rotating out in six annual stages from that year onward, to reduce heavy expense.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year southern-route rotation garrisons were ordered to rotate out in six annual stages from that year on, to reduce expense.

sentences.zh: 天山以南，為回部所居，自設台站、卡倫，無俟重兵防守。

translations.literal: South of the Tianshan, where the Muslim peoples dwelt, postal stations and karun were established on their own; heavy garrisons were not needed for defense.
translations.idiomatic: South of the Tianshan, where the Muslim peoples lived, postal stations and karun sufficed without heavy garrisons.

sentences.zh: 烏什、葉爾羌、喀什噶爾、英阿薩爾咸以滿、漢兵協力守邊。

translations.literal: Ush, Yarkand, Kashgar, and Ying'asar all relied on Manchu and Han troops jointly to guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Ush, Yarkand, Kashgar, and Ying'asar all relied on joint Manchu and Han garrisons to guard the frontier.

sentences.zh: 他如和闐、阿克蘇、庫車、哈喇沙爾、辟展則守以綠旗兵。

translations.literal: Others such as Khotan, Aksu, Kucha, Karashahr, and Pizhan were guarded by Green Standard troops.
translations.idiomatic: Khotan, Aksu, Kucha, Karashahr, and Pizhan were guarded by Green Standard troops.

sentences.zh: 凡滿洲營駐防兵，以三年更換，綠旗營駐防兵，以五年更換。

translations.literal: Manchu camp garrison troops rotated every three years; Green Standard camp garrison troops every five years.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu garrison troops rotated every three years; Green Standard garrison troops every five years.

sentences.zh: 此南路之制也。

translations.literal: Such was the system of the southern route.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the southern-route system.

sentences.zh: 同治以來，回疆不靖，欽差大臣左宗棠次第殄平之，新疆漸歸版籍。

translations.literal: Since the Tongzhi reign the Muslim frontier had been unsettled; Imperial Commissioner Zuo Zongtang gradually exterminated the rebels, and Xinjiang gradually returned to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Since Tongzhi the Muslim frontier had been unsettled; Imperial Commissioner Zuo Zongtang gradually pacified the region, and Xinjiang gradually returned to the empire.

sentences.zh: 光緒初年，改省議起。

translations.literal: In the early Guangxu reign, debate over converting the region into a province arose.
translations.idiomatic: In early Guangxu debate began over converting Xinjiang into a province.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠擬令將軍率旗營駐伊犁，塔爾巴哈台改設都統，並統綠、旗各營。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang proposed that the general lead banner troops garrisoned at Ili, that Tarbagatai be changed to a military governorship, and that both Green Standard and banner camps be unified under one command.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang proposed that the general lead banner troops at Ili, that Tarbagatai be made a military governorship, and that Green Standard and banner camps be unified under one command.

sentences.zh: 迨八年收復伊犁，從譚鍾麟、劉錦棠言，於南北兩路增設額兵，其舊有參贊、辦事、領隊各大臣悉予裁汰。

translations.literal: When in the eighth year Ili was recovered, following the advice of Tan Zhonglin and Liu Jintang, quota troops were added on the northern and southern routes, and the former resident commissioners, resident ministers, and brigade ministers were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: When Ili was recovered in the eighth year, following Tan Zhonglin and Liu Jintang, quota troops were added on both routes and the former resident commissioners, resident ministers, and brigade ministers were all abolished.

sentences.zh: 即自哈密至伊犁都統暨諸大臣名額亦酌撤之。

translations.literal: Accordingly, from Hami to Ili the posts of military governor and the various ministers were also partially abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Posts from Hami to Ili, including the military governorship and various ministerial offices, were also partially abolished.

sentences.zh: 巴里坤、古城、烏魯木齊、庫爾喀拉烏蘇等處所餘旗丁，歸併伊犁滿營，均改從各省駐防將軍營制。

translations.literal: Banner households remaining at Barkul, Gucheng, Urumqi, Kurkara Usu, and other places were merged into the Ili Manchu camp and all changed to the garrison system of provincial garrison generals.
translations.idiomatic: Banner households remaining at Barkul, Gucheng, Urumqi, Kurkara Usu, and elsewhere were merged into the Ili Manchu camp and reorganized under the provincial garrison-general system.

sentences.zh: 十一年，行省製成。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the provincial system was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the provincial system was completed.

sentences.zh: 伊犁旗營實存勇七千，留其精壯，改馬隊九旗，步隊十三旗，以提督、總兵分領之。

translations.literal: The Ili banner camp actually had seven thousand braves on the rolls; the elite were retained and reorganized into nine cavalry banners and thirteen infantry banners, with regional and brigade commanders assigned to command them separately.
translations.idiomatic: The Ili banner camp mustered seven thousand braves; the elite were kept and reorganized into nine cavalry and thirteen infantry banners under regional and brigade commanders.

sentences.zh: 伊犁開屯由此始，而旗屯居其一焉。

translations.literal: Ili colonization began from this point, and banner colonization formed one part of it.
translations.idiomatic: Ili colonization began at this point, with banner colonization as one component.

sentences.zh: 蓋新疆自籓部迄於設行省，綜其駐防旗兵制度，約略如此。

translations.literal: In sum, from frontier-department status to the establishment of provincial administration, the garrison banner system of Xinjiang was roughly as described above.
translations.idiomatic: In sum, from frontier-department status to provincial administration, Xinjiang's garrison banner system was roughly as described above.

sentences.zh: 其籓部兵制，曰內外蒙古，曰青海，曰西藏。

translations.literal: Its frontier-department military systems were those of Inner and Outer Mongolia, Qinghai, and Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Its frontier military systems covered Inner and Outer Mongolia, Qinghai, and Tibet.

sentences.zh: 內外蒙古之兵，設旗編次，略同內八旗。

translations.literal: The troops of Inner and Outer Mongolia were organized by banners in ranks, broadly similar to the inner Eight Banners.
translations.idiomatic: Inner and Outer Mongol troops were organized in banners, broadly on the inner Eight Banner model.

sentences.zh: 每旗設札薩克一人，汗、王、貝勒、貝子、公、台吉為之。

translations.literal: Each banner had one Zasak established, drawn from khans, princes, beile, beise, gong, and taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Each banner had one Zasak, drawn from khans, princes, beile, beise, gong, and taiji ranks.

sentences.zh: 協理旗務二或四人，亦台吉以上充任。

translations.literal: Two or four banner-affairs coordinators were appointed, also filled by men of taiji rank and above.
translations.idiomatic: Two or four banner-affairs coordinators were appointed, likewise from taiji rank and above.

sentences.zh: 按丁數編為佐領。

translations.literal: By registered male quota they were organized into companies.
translations.idiomatic: Registered males were organized into companies by quota.

sentences.zh: 設佐領一，驍騎校六。

translations.literal: One company commander and six vanguard corporals were established.
translations.idiomatic: Each unit had one company commander and six vanguard corporals.

sentences.zh: 每六佐領設參領一人。

translations.literal: For every six companies one regimental commander was established.
translations.idiomatic: Every six companies had one regimental commander.

sentences.zh: 佐領較多者，設章京、副章京。

translations.literal: Where companies were more numerous, clerks and deputy clerks were established.
translations.idiomatic: Banners with more companies also had clerks and deputy clerks.

sentences.zh: 各率所屬以聽於札薩克。

translations.literal: Each led his subordinates to obey the Zasak.
translations.idiomatic: Each led his subordinates under the Zasak's command.

sentences.zh: 內札薩克蒙古凡二十四部、四十九旗。

translations.literal: Inner Zasak Mongols numbered twenty-four tribes and forty-nine banners in all.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Zasak Mongols comprised twenty-four tribes and forty-nine banners in all.

sentences.zh: 科爾沁六旗，分左右二翼，二翼又各分前後旗。

translations.literal: The Khorchin had six banners, divided into left and right wings; each wing was further divided into front and rear banners.
translations.idiomatic: The Khorchin had six banners in left and right wings, each wing further divided into front and rear banners.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，設左翼旗、左翼前旗、右翼旗、右翼前後旗。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, the Left Wing Banner, Left Front Banner, Right Wing Banner, and Right Front and Rear Banners were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde the Left Wing, Left Front, Right Wing, and Right Front and Rear banners were established.

sentences.zh: 順治六年，設左翼後旗。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Shunzhi, the Left Rear Banner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Shunzhi the Left Rear Banner was established.

sentences.zh: 郭爾羅斯前後二旗，杜爾伯特一旗，扎賚特一旗，皆順治五年設。

translations.literal: Gorlos Front and Rear Banners, one Dorbed Banner, and one Jasagt Banner were all established in the fifth year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The Gorlos Front and Rear banners, one Dorbed banner, and one Jasagt banner were all established in the fifth year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 扎魯特二旗，左翼崇德元年設，右翼順治五年設。

translations.literal: The Jarud had two banners; the Left Wing was established in the first year of Chongde and the Right Wing in the fifth year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The Jarud had two banners: the Left Wing established in the first year of Chongde and the Right Wing in the fifth year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀左翼一旗，康熙三年設。

translations.literal: One Khalkha Left Wing Banner was established in the third year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: One Khalkha Left Wing banner was established in the third year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 奈曼一旗，敖漢一旗，皆崇德元年設。

translations.literal: One Naiman Banner and one Aohan Banner were both established in the first year of Chongde.
translations.idiomatic: One Naiman banner and one Aohan banner were both established in the first year of Chongde.

sentences.zh: 土默特二旗，左翼崇德元年設，右翼順治二年設。

translations.literal: The Tumed had two banners; the Left Wing was established in the first year of Chongde and the Right Wing in the second year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The Tumed had two banners: the Left Wing established in the first year of Chongde and the Right Wing in the second year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 喀喇沁三旗，右翼崇德元年設，左翼順治五年設，康熙中增設一旗。

translations.literal: The Kharachin had three banners; the Right Wing was established in the first year of Chongde, the Left Wing in the fifth year of Shunzhi, and one banner was added in the Kangxi reign.
translations.idiomatic: The Kharachin had three banners: the Right Wing in the first year of Chongde, the Left Wing in the fifth year of Shunzhi, and one added in the Kangxi reign.

sentences.zh: 翁牛特左右二旗，阿魯科爾沁一旗，皆崇德元年設。

translations.literal: Onnigud Left and Right Banners and one Aru Khorchin Banner were all established in the first year of Chongde.
translations.idiomatic: The Onnigud Left and Right banners and one Aru Khorchin banner were all established in the first year of Chongde.

sentences.zh: 巴林左右二旗，順治五年設。

translations.literal: Bairin Left and Right Banners were established in the fifth year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The Bairin Left and Right banners were established in the fifth year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 克什克騰一旗，順治三年設。

translations.literal: One Keshiketeng Banner was established in the third year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: One Keshiketeng banner was established in the third year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 烏珠穆沁二旗，右翼崇德六年設，左翼順治三年設。

translations.literal: The Ujimqin had two banners; the Right Wing was established in the sixth year of Chongde and the Left Wing in the third year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The Ujimqin had two banners: the Right Wing in the sixth year of Chongde and the Left Wing in the third year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 浩齊特二旗，順治三年設左翼，十年設右翼。

translations.literal: The Khoit had two banners; the Left Wing was established in the third year of Shunzhi and the Right Wing in the tenth year.
translations.idiomatic: The Khoit had two banners: the Left Wing in the third year of Shunzhi and the Right Wing in the tenth year.

sentences.zh: 阿巴哈納爾二旗，康熙四年設左翼，六年設右翼。

translations.literal: The Abag had two banners; the Left Wing was established in the fourth year of Kangxi and the Right Wing in the sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: The Abag had two banners: the Left Wing in the fourth year of Kangxi and the Right Wing in the sixth year.

sentences.zh: 阿巴噶二旗，崇德六年設右翼，順治八年設左翼。

translations.literal: The Abaga had two banners; the Right Wing was established in the sixth year of Chongde and the Left Wing in the eighth year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The Abaga had two banners: the Right Wing in the sixth year of Chongde and the Left Wing in the eighth year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 蘇尼特二旗，崇德六年設左翼，七年設右翼。

translations.literal: The Sunid had two banners; the Left Wing was established in the sixth year of Chongde and the Right Wing in the seventh year.
translations.idiomatic: The Sunid had two banners: the Left Wing in the sixth year of Chongde and the Right Wing in the seventh year.

sentences.zh: 四子部落一旗，順治八年設。

translations.literal: One Dörben Oirat Banner was established in the eighth year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: One Dörben Oirat banner was established in the eighth year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 烏喇特右翼一旗，順治十年設。

translations.literal: One Urad Right Wing Banner was established in the tenth year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: One Urad Right Wing banner was established in the tenth year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 茂明安一旗，順治元年設。

translations.literal: One Muuminggan Banner was established in the first year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: One Muuminggan banner was established in the first year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 烏喇特前中後三旗，順治五年設。

translations.literal: Urad Front, Middle, and Rear Banners were established in the fifth year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The Urad Front, Middle, and Rear banners were established in the fifth year of Shunzhi.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾多斯七旗，兩翼、中旗、前旗、後旗皆順治六年設，雍正九年，增設一旗。

translations.literal: Ordos had seven banners; the two wings, central banner, front banner, and rear banner were all established in the sixth year of Shunzhi; in the ninth year of Yongzheng one banner was added.
translations.idiomatic: Ordos had seven banners: the two wings, central, front, and rear banners in the sixth year of Shunzhi, with one added in the ninth year of Yongzheng.

sentences.zh: 歸化城土默特左右二旗，崇德元年設，後置副都統，隸綏遠城將軍轄之。

translations.literal: Guihuacheng Tumed Left and Right Banners were established in the first year of Chongde; later a deputy commander-in-chief was placed over them, subordinate to the Suiyuan garrison general.
translations.idiomatic: The Guihuacheng Tumed Left and Right banners were established in the first year of Chongde; later a deputy commander was placed over them under the Suiyuan garrison general.

sentences.zh: 是為內蒙古兵制。

translations.literal: Such was the military system of Inner Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the Inner Mongolian military system.

sentences.zh: 外札薩克蒙古，喀爾喀四部，凡八十六旗。

translations.literal: Outer Zasak Mongols of the four Khalkha divisions numbered eighty-six banners in all.
translations.idiomatic: Outer Zasak Mongols of the four Khalkha divisions comprised eighty-six banners in all.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀土謝圖汗部二十旗為中路。

translations.literal: The Khalkha Tushiyetu Khan division, with twenty banners, formed the central route.
translations.idiomatic: The Khalkha Tushiyetu Khan division, with twenty banners, formed the central route.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十年，設十七旗。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Kangxi, seventeen banners were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Kangxi seventeen banners were established.

sentences.zh: 逮雍正間，遞增至三十八旗。

translations.literal: By the Yongzheng reign they had gradually increased to thirty-eight banners.
translations.idiomatic: By the Yongzheng reign they had gradually increased to thirty-eight banners.

sentences.zh: 尋分二十旗屬三音諾顏部，存十八旗。

translations.literal: Soon twenty banners were assigned to the Sain Noyan division, leaving eighteen banners.
translations.idiomatic: Soon twenty banners were assigned to the Sain Noyan division, leaving eighteen.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，復增二旗，於本旗外分十九札薩克掌之，仍統於土謝圖汗部。

translations.literal: In the early Qianlong reign two banners were added again; outside the original banners nineteen Zasaks were appointed to govern them, still under the Tushiyetu Khan division.
translations.idiomatic: In early Qianlong two banners were added; outside the original banners nineteen Zasaks were appointed to govern them, still under the Tushiyetu Khan division.

sentences.zh: 車臣汗部二十三旗為東路。

translations.literal: The Setsen Khan division, with twenty-three banners, formed the eastern route.
translations.idiomatic: The Setsen Khan division, with twenty-three banners, formed the eastern route.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十年，設十二旗。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Kangxi, twelve banners were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Kangxi twelve banners were established.

sentences.zh: 其後增至二十一旗。

translations.literal: They later increased to twenty-one banners.
translations.idiomatic: They later increased to twenty-one banners.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，遞增二旗，於本旗外分二十二札薩克掌之，仍統於車臣汗。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign two banners were gradually added; outside the original banners twenty-two Zasaks were appointed to govern them, still under the Setsen Khan.
translations.idiomatic: During Qianlong two banners were added; outside the original banners twenty-two Zasaks were appointed to govern them, still under the Setsen Khan.

sentences.zh: 札薩克圖汗部十七旗為西路。

translations.literal: The Zasagt Khan division, with seventeen banners, formed the western route.
translations.idiomatic: The Zasagt Khan division, with seventeen banners, formed the western route.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十年，設八旗。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Kangxi, eight banners were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Kangxi eight banners were established.

sentences.zh: 逮雍正間，遞增至十五旗。

translations.literal: By the Yongzheng reign they had gradually increased to fifteen banners.
translations.idiomatic: By the Yongzheng reign they had gradually increased to fifteen banners.

sentences.zh: 乾隆時，遞增二旗，於本旗外分十六札薩克掌之，仍統於札薩克圖汗。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign two banners were gradually added; outside the original banners sixteen Zasaks were appointed to govern them, still under the Zasagt Khan.
translations.idiomatic: During Qianlong two banners were added; outside the original banners sixteen Zasaks were appointed to govern them, still under the Zasagt Khan.

sentences.zh: 三音諾顏親王部二十二旗，雍正十年設，即於土謝圖汗部內分轄二十旗。

translations.literal: The Sain Noyan princely division, with twenty-two banners, was established in the tenth year of Yongzheng; twenty banners were split off from within the Tushiyetu Khan division to form it.
translations.idiomatic: The Sain Noyan princely division, with twenty-two banners, was established in the tenth year of Yongzheng by splitting twenty banners from the Tushiyetu Khan division.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，增二旗，於本旗外分二十一札薩克掌之，仍統於三音諾顏札薩克親王。

translations.literal: In the early Qianlong reign two banners were added; outside the original banners twenty-one Zasaks were appointed to govern them, still under the Sain Noyan Zasak prince.
translations.idiomatic: In early Qianlong two banners were added; outside the original banners twenty-one Zasaks were appointed to govern them, still under the Sain Noyan Zasak prince.

sentences.zh: 烏蘭烏蘇厄魯特部二旗，康熙二十五年分設。

translations.literal: The Ulan Usu Oirat division, with two banners, was split off in the twenty-fifth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: The Ulan Usu Oirat division, with two banners, was split off in the twenty-fifth year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，隸移烏蘭烏蘇並隸三音諾顏部。

translations.literal: During the Qianlong reign their jurisdiction was moved to Ulan Usu and they were also placed under the Sain Noyan division.
translations.idiomatic: During Qianlong their jurisdiction was moved to Ulan Usu and they were placed under the Sain Noyan division.

sentences.zh: 賀蘭山厄魯特一旗，康熙三十六年設。

translations.literal: One Helanshan Oirat Banner was established in the thirty-sixth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: One Helanshan Oirat banner was established in the thirty-sixth year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 青海厄魯特部二十一旗，雍正三年設二十旗，乾隆十一年增設一旗。

translations.literal: The Qinghai Oirat division had twenty-one banners; twenty were established in the third year of Yongzheng and one was added in the eleventh year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: The Qinghai Oirat division had twenty-one banners: twenty established in the third year of Yongzheng and one added in the eleventh year of Qianlong.

sentences.zh: 青海游牧綽羅斯部二旗，輝特部一旗，土爾扈特部一旗，喀爾喀部一旗，皆雍正三年設。

translations.literal: Qinghai nomadic Choros two banners, Khoid one banner, Torghut one banner, and Khalkha one banner were all established in the third year of Yongzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai's nomadic Choros two banners, Khoid one banner, Torghut one banner, and Khalkha one banner were all established in the third year of Yongzheng.

sentences.zh: 哈密一旗，康熙三十六年設。

translations.literal: One Hami Banner was established in the thirty-sixth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: One Hami banner was established in the thirty-sixth year of Kangxi.

sentences.zh: 吐魯番一旗，雍正十年設。

translations.literal: One Turfan Banner was established in the tenth year of Yongzheng.
translations.idiomatic: One Turfan banner was established in the tenth year of Yongzheng.

sentences.zh: 都爾伯特十四旗，乾隆十八年編設。

translations.literal: Fourteen Dorben banners were organized and established in the eighteenth year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Dorben banners were established in the eighteenth year of Qianlong (1753).

sentences.zh: 土爾扈特部，乾隆三十六年編設。

translations.literal: The Torghut tribe was organized and established in the thirty-sixth year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: The Torghut tribe was organized into banners in the thirty-sixth year of Qianlong (1771).

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年，定每年春季，王、貝勒以各旗下台吉兵丁合操。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi it was fixed that each spring, princes and beile should conduct joint drill with the taiji soldiers of each banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi (1674) it was ordered that each spring princes and beile conduct joint maneuvers with their banners' taiji and troops.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，諭內札薩克六會，防秋兵丁各備牧馬器械，分二班，錫林郭勒、烏蘭察布、伊克昭三會為一班，哲里木、昭烏達、卓索圖三會為一班，以大札薩克為盟長，每年遣大臣會同盟長，按旗察閱兵丁。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong an edict was issued to the six Inner jasak leagues: autumn-border soldiers of each league were to prepare pasture horses and weapons, divided into two shifts—Xilin Gol, Ulan Cab, and Ike Juu leagues as one shift, Zhorin, Juu Uda, and Josutu leagues as another—with the senior jasak as league chief; each year an imperial minister was dispatched to join the league chief in inspecting troops by banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong (1736) the six Inner jasak leagues were instructed to ready pasture horses and arms for autumn border duty in two shifts: Xilin Gol, Ulan Cab, and Ike Juu as one, Zhorin, Juu Uda, and Josutu as the other, under senior jasak league chiefs, with an imperial envoy sent annually to inspect each banner's troops alongside the league chief.

sentences.zh: 其喀爾喀四部游牧防守兵萬人，遣參贊大臣同喀爾喀將軍、貝勒、公等分年簡稽軍實。

translations.literal: As for the ten thousand Khalkha nomadic border-defense soldiers of the four divisions, a supervising minister was dispatched with the Khalkha general, beile, dukes, and others to inspect military readiness in rotation by year.
translations.idiomatic: For the ten thousand Khalkha nomads serving as border-defense troops across four divisions, a supervising minister was sent with the Khalkha general, beile, and dukes to inspect troop strength in yearly rotation.

sentences.zh: 三年，命賞六會防秋牧馬之兵，視康熙間成例，分給弓矢、衣服、銀兩有差。

translations.literal: In the third year it was ordered to reward soldiers of the six leagues on autumn-border horse-pasture duty, following Kangxi-era precedents, distributing bows and arrows, clothing, and silver in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1738) troops on autumn border and pasture duty in the six leagues were rewarded according to Kangxi precedents with graded allotments of bows and arrows, clothing, and silver.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，諭蒙古兵丁應習圍場者，車臣汗、土謝圖汗二部，由庫倫辦事王、大臣，三音諾顏、札薩克圖汗二部，由烏里雅蘇台將軍、大臣等分領練習，並令各部落汗、王、公選大台吉各四人，小台吉十人，赴木蘭圍場。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year an edict was issued that Mongol soldiers who should practice at the hunting grounds: the two divisions of Tsetsen Khan and Tüsheet Khan were led in practice by the prince and minister at Urga; the two divisions of Sain Noyon Khan and Zasagt Khan by the general and ministers at Uliastai; and each tribal khan, prince, and duke was also ordered to select four senior taiji and ten junior taiji to proceed to the Mulan hunting grounds.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year (1786) Mongol troops required to train at the imperial hunting grounds were assigned: Tsetsen Khan and Tüsheet Khan divisions under the Urga prince and minister; Sain Noyon Khan and Zasagt Khan divisions under the Uliastai general and his staff. Each tribal khan, prince, and duke was to select four senior and ten junior taiji for service at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 道光三年，從陝甘總督那彥成言，以青海二十四旗分左右二翼，每翼設盟長、副盟長，每六旗設霍碩扎爾噶齊，每三旗設一梅勒，每旗設一甲喇，各旗兵按人數之多寡，隨官兵番值巡防。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daoguang, following the memorial of Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Nayancheng, Qinghai's twenty-four banners were divided into left and right wings; each wing received a league chief and deputy league chief; every six banners received one hoshuu jargalchi; every three banners one meiren; every banner one jalan; soldiers of each banner, according to their numbers, took turns with officials and native troops on patrol.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Daoguang (1823), at Nayancheng's suggestion, Qinghai's twenty-four banners were split into left and right wings, each with a league chief and deputy. One hoshuu jargalchi was placed over every six banners, one meiren over every three, and one jalan over each banner, with banner soldiers rotating patrol duty with officials according to their numbers.

sentences.zh: 十一年，允楊遇春請，以蒙古兵五百人析為二班，分防八卡。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Yang Yuchun's request was granted: five hundred Mongol soldiers were divided into two shifts to garrison eight karun.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1831) Yang Yuchun's proposal was approved: five hundred Mongol troops were split into two shifts to guard eight karun posts.

sentences.zh: 十五年，諭令察哈爾兵丁選補缺額，與札薩克游牧共衛北邊。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year an edict ordered Chahar soldiers to fill vacant quotas and join jasak nomads in jointly guarding the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1835) Chahar troops were ordered to fill vacancies and join jasak nomads in guarding the northern border.

sentences.zh: 同治十年，諭邊外各路台站，都統或盟長分任管轄。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Tongzhi an edict was issued that postal stations on all frontier routes were to be placed under the separate jurisdiction of commandants or league chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Tongzhi (1871) frontier postal stations were assigned to commandants or league chiefs for separate administration.

sentences.zh: 每台額定駱駝百頭，馬五十匹，戈壁地備駱駝百五十頭。

translations.literal: Each station was allotted one hundred camels and fifty horses; for Gobi terrain one hundred fifty camels were kept in reserve.
translations.idiomatic: Each station was allocated one hundred camels and fifty horses, with one hundred fifty camels held in reserve for Gobi routes.

sentences.zh: 此內外蒙古及青海兵制也。

translations.literal: Such was the military organization of Inner and Outer Mongolia and Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the military system of Inner and Outer Mongolia and Qinghai.

sentences.zh: 蒙古各盟，當雍、乾時，征討准、回，資其兵力以集事。

translations.literal: The Mongol leagues, in the Yongzheng and Qianlong eras when campaigns were waged against the Dzungars and Muslims, supplied their military strength to accomplish the task.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns, when the court campaigned against the Dzungars and the Muslim regions, the Mongol leagues furnished troops that made those expeditions possible.

sentences.zh: 自俄人闌入，烏蘭海南北並受羈牽，喀魯倫東西侵為田牧，雜居無限，卡倫鄂博，蓋同虛設矣。

translations.literal: Since Russians intruded, both north and south of the Ulan Hai came under constraint; east and west of the Kerulen were encroached upon for fields and pasture; mixed settlement became boundless—and karun and oboo markers were effectively void.
translations.idiomatic: Once Russians began to intrude, both sides of the Ulan Hai fell under foreign pressure; fields and pastures east and west of the Kerulen were overrun; peoples mixed without limit—and border karun and oboo posts became little more than fiction.

sentences.zh: 西藏旗兵，自乾隆五十七年始。

translations.literal: Tibetan banner soldiers began from the fifty-seventh year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan banner troops dated from the fifty-seventh year of Qianlong (1792).

sentences.zh: 前後藏各設番兵千。

translations.literal: Front and rear Tibet each had one thousand native troops established.
translations.idiomatic: Front Tibet and rear Tibet each received one thousand native troops.

sentences.zh: 定日、江孜各設五百。

translations.literal: Tingri and Gyantse each had five hundred established.
translations.idiomatic: Tingri and Gyantse each received five hundred men.

sentences.zh: 前藏領兵者曰戴琫，其下如琫，又下甲琫、定琫。

translations.literal: The commander of front-Tibet native troops was called a daibing; below him was rubing, and below that jia'bing and dingbing.
translations.idiomatic: Front-Tibet native troops were led by daibing officers; beneath them stood rubing, then jia'bing and dingbing.

sentences.zh: 原置戴琫三人，二駐後藏，一駐定日，復增戴琫一人駐江孜。

translations.literal: Originally three daibing were established—two garrisoned in rear Tibet, one in Tingri—then one more daibing was added garrisoned at Gyantse.
translations.idiomatic: Three daibing were originally posted—two in rear Tibet, one in Tingri—later augmented by a fourth stationed at Gyantse.

sentences.zh: 前藏番兵，游擊統之。

translations.literal: Front-Tibet native troops were commanded by a brigade-general.
translations.idiomatic: Front-Tibet native troops fell under a brigade-general.

sentences.zh: 後藏及江孜、定日，都司統之。

translations.literal: Rear Tibet, Gyantse, and Tingri were commanded by battalion commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Rear Tibet, Gyantse, and Tingri were each commanded by battalion commanders.

sentences.zh: 原有唐古特兵，歸戴琫督練。

translations.literal: The existing Tangut troops were placed under the daibing for supervised training.
translations.idiomatic: Existing Tangut troops were assigned to daibing officers for training.

sentences.zh: 初制，每番兵千，弓箭三之，鳥槍七之。

translations.literal: Under the initial regulation, of each thousand native troops, three-tenths bore bow and arrow and seven-tenths bore musket.
translations.idiomatic: At first each thousand native troops were armed three-tenths with bow and arrow, seven-tenths with musket.

sentences.zh: 嗣選唐古特兵三千，鳥槍、刀矛各半。

translations.literal: Subsequently three thousand Tangut soldiers were selected, half with muskets and half with blade and spear.
translations.idiomatic: Later three thousand Tangut soldiers were selected, armed half with muskets and half with blade and spear.

sentences.zh: 至是新設額兵三千，每千人五成鳥槍，三成弓矢，二成刀矛。

translations.literal: At this point three thousand newly established quota soldiers were set: of each thousand, fifty percent muskets, thirty percent bow and arrow, twenty percent blade and spear.
translations.idiomatic: At this point three thousand new regular troops were created: per thousand, fifty percent muskets, thirty percent bow and arrow, twenty percent blade and spear.

sentences.zh: 其唐古特兵，由駐防將領督同番目教練。

translations.literal: These Tangut troops were trained by the garrison commander together with native petty officers.
translations.idiomatic: Tangut troops were drilled by the garrison commander along with native petty officers.

sentences.zh: 前藏駐游擊、守備各一，千總二，把總三，外委五。

translations.literal: Front Tibet garrisoned one brigade-general and one garrison commandant, two thousand-man captains, three platoon captains, and five acting subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: Front Tibet held one brigade-general, one garrison commandant, two thousand-man captains, three platoon captains, and five acting subordinates.

sentences.zh: 後藏駐游擊、都司各一，守備三，千總二，把總七，外委九。

translations.literal: Rear Tibet garrisoned one brigade-general and one battalion commander, three garrison commandants, two thousand-man captains, seven platoon captains, and nine acting subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: Rear Tibet held one brigade-general, one battalion commander, three garrison commandants, two thousand-man captains, seven platoon captains, and nine acting subordinates.

sentences.zh: 是年，以福康安疏請江孜增守備一，外委一，兵三十人，定日增守備一，把總一，外委一，兵四十人。

translations.literal: That year, on Fuk'anggan's memorial request, Gyantse received one additional garrison commandant, one acting subordinate, and thirty soldiers; Tingri received one additional garrison commandant, one platoon captain, one acting subordinate, and forty soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: That year, at Fuk'anggan's request, Gyantse gained a garrison commandant, an acting subordinate, and thirty troops; Tingri gained a garrison commandant, a platoon captain, an acting subordinate, and forty troops.

sentences.zh: 尋用和琳疏言，定日要隘曰轄爾多，曰察木達杏嶺，曰古喇噶木洞，曰宗喀，每處各設定琫一人，番兵二十五人。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward Helin's memorial was adopted: at Tingri's strategic passes—Xia'erduo, Chamda Xingling, Gulagamudong, and Zongka—each place was given one dingbing and twenty-five native soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, following Helin's memorial, the Tingri passes at Xia'erduo, Chamda Xingling, Gulagamudong, and Zongka each received a dingbing and twenty-five native troops.

sentences.zh: 此西藏兵制大略也。

translations.literal: Such was the general outline of Tibet's military organization.
translations.idiomatic: Such, in broad outline, was Tibet's military system.

sentences.zh: 當乾隆十五年，始除西藏王爵，設駐藏大臣，以達賴喇嘛統前藏，班禪統後藏。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Qianlong the Tibetan kingship was first abolished, a resident minister for Tibet was established, the Dalai Lama was put in charge of front Tibet, and the Panchen in charge of rear Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Qianlong (1750) the Tibetan kingly title was abolished, a resident minister was appointed for Tibet, the Dalai Lama was placed over front Tibet, and the Panchen over rear Tibet.
